high_level_description: The image depicts a large, modern data center or server room belonging to Cerebras, an AI chip firm. The setting is clean and well-lit, with a high ceiling featuring exposed ductwork and lighting fixtures. The floor is smooth and reflective, adding to the professional and organized atmosphere. On either side of the corridor, there are large white cabinets or servers, each bearing the Cerebras logo prominently displayed on the front. The logo consists of the word "cerebras" in lowercase letters, accompanied by a stylized orange and red circular design.
